node.statement: Work throughout in the branch S_P!={0}, so node 1.3.3.1 defines every a_m as a finite nonnegative real and supplies P(0): a_{2^0}=a_1>=r_+(e). For k>=0, let P(k) denote a_{2^k}>=r_+(e). Node 1.3.3.2 proves P(k)=>P(k+1). Therefore the ordinary induction principle gives P(k) for every integer k>=0. No a_m is formed in the excluded branch S_P={0}; that branch was separately discharged in node 1.3.3.1.
